name: Tamba (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Tamba city emblem in white: an outlined trefoil-like device with two leaves at the sides.
history: Municipal flag of Tamba, a city in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 2004.

features.role: Tamba city emblem — an outlined trefoil-like device with two leaves at the sides
